description:
Find the category code from words: "air fryer", "juegos de mesa", "vitamin C serum", "puzzles".
(Busca el código de una categoría a partir de palabras, en español o en inglés.)

Call it before any other tool when you do not know the exact `categoria`: never guess codes. Returns up to 15
matches, best first, with `categoria` and `pais` (pass them as they come to the other tools), the name, `nivel`
("match": every tool; "scan": wintraits_scan_perfil, wintraits_ranking, wintraits_chequeo_rapido,
wintraits_chequeo_asin) and the link. With no match, use wintraits_categorias_disponibles.

Args:
    texto: what the user sells or wants to sell, in Spanish or English.
    pais: preferred country code ("ES", "FR", "DE", "IT"); matches in that country come first.
    lang: "es" (default) or "en".

Free and unlimited during the beta (until 2027-03-31). Gratis y sin límite durante la beta (hasta el 31-mar-2027).
name: wintraits_buscar_categoria
